text:
maya: Quick sync — CloudWave wants a ‘one‑click’ deploy for our reference stack (OrbitalStack). They asked for Terraform modules + a tiny Helm chart. Can we scope what the partner-facing deliverables look like? :rocket:
jordan: Is this for marketplace listing (cloud marketplace) or a partner-managed repo for customers?
liam: CloudWave wants marketplace listing with a 'deploy to CloudWave' button. We need a module, README, and a smoke test. Also a validated AMI/VM image for Dedicated.
irene: Timeline? They want a joint announcement in ~4 weeks. That’s tight but doable if we scope minimal MVP: terraform module + example composition + CI smoke.
maya: MVP list I sketched: 1) terraform module (inputs: region, instance_type, disk_size, model_version) 2) example overlay using our refarch 3) CI that runs terratest and deploys to a sandbox 4) small Helm chart for optional sidecar metrics 5) MD docs and a prebuilt image.
alex: I can own the terraform module. Quick question: do we need to support multiple providers (GCP/AWS)? CloudWave is AWS-first but wants GCP later. For MVP, target AWS and document multi-cloud extension.
jordan: Agree. For marketplace listing we also need a quickstart template (CloudFormation or marketplace packaging). For now, provide Terraform + a conversion guide.
liam: CI plan: Github Actions that runs `terraform init && terraform apply -auto-approve` in a sandbox account, then runs a small http check against the service endpoint. Tear down after. Add a test job that validates KV cache persists across restarts (smoke).
irene: Docs checklist: architecture diagram, resource pricing estimate, permissions/assume-role snippet, security checklist (KMS integration, no secrets in repo), and rollback instructions.
maya: Example assume-role snippet for partner docs:```hcl
provider "aws" {
  region = var.region
  assume_role {
    role_arn = var.partner_role_arn
  }
}
```
alex: Nice. For module interface propose vars: `region`, `instance_profile`, `gpu_type`, `model_repo`, `enable_metrics` — keep defaults sane.
jordan: Can someone drop a link to the refarch repo we should base the module on?
maya: Link: https://redwood.internal/repos/refarch/orbitalstack (private) — base example is `examples/marketplace/aws` there.
liam: I'll stub the GH Actions workflow and terratest script today. Will ping when PR is up.
irene: I'll draft the partner docs template and security checklist; want to include KMS integration snippet.
deploy-bot: docs-bot: created wiki page: /partners/cloudwave-orbitalstack-onboarding (internal).
maya: Great. Next steps: Alex build module skeleton, Liam CI, Irene docs. We'll sync Thurs 10am to review PRs. @alex @liam @irene please ack. :eyes:
alex: Ack, slot booked.
liam: Ack, will have initial PR by EOD tomorrow.
irene: Ack, will draft docs and checklist by EOD tomorrow.
maya: Thanks everyone — if we can keep scope tight we can hit the joint announcement window.
